required_artifact_semantics: IEEE binary32 RNE with gradual underflow
separate binary32 products and additions in GEMV dot and norm sum-of-squares accumulation; no reassociation of those source operations
BF16 RNE narrowing with finite intermediate and output rejection
reviewed norm sqrt_f32 route within one binary32 ULP of correctly rounded sqrt; this is an artifact prerequisite, not a theorem established by CPU tests
reviewed OCML Exp provider for stable SiLU

norm.policy: Outward FP64 sum-square envelope; monotone rounded F32 mean, epsilon, sqrt and reciprocal intervals; first BF16 RNE cell intersection, then separate F32 weight product and second BF16 RNE. Exact signed zero for zero input. Candidate cap refuses uncertainty; it never widens tolerance.

gate_up.policy: Independent FP64 dot conditional on actual accepted normalized BF16; observed BF16 rounding cell must intersect the outward F32 accumulation envelope.

swiglu.policy: Independent FP64 stable SiLU on actual accepted gate/up BF16; finite BF16 result, at most one ordered-BF16 step, exact signed zero when gate or up is zero. This is preregistered numerical qualification, not an all-input OCML error theorem.

down.policy: Independent FP64 dot conditional on actual accepted activation BF16; actual finite FP32 error bounded by gamma103 plus gamma6144_f64 times outward sum of absolute products and underflow allowance.

residual.policy: Exact integer-bit binary32 RNE sequence +0, rank0 down partial, rank1 down partial, actual replicated first residual; one final BF16 RNE. Both ranks must match exactly.

claims.unconditioned_mlp_fp64_diagnostic: Retains BF16 boundaries and uses only actual first residual, not GPU intermediate arrays; no aggregate acceptance threshold.
